newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says steel profit falls 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says steel profit falls 39 pct.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Dec 20 - The Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd said on Friday that the 39 percent fall in first half steel division profits to A$180 million was mainly due to significantly lower export prices for Australian and New Zealand production.

BHP said other factors affecting the result were higher costs associated with the reline of the Number Four blast furnace at Newcastle, higher raw material, labour and early retirement scheme costs, a better manufacturing performance, and the consolidation of Tubemakers.
